BOOK ONE · LESSON 093

Our new neighbour

我们的新邻居

A monologue lesson about Nigel, a pilot who is the family's new next-door neighbour. He was in the Royal Air Force, is only forty-one years old, and has already been to nearly every country in the world. He is currently in Madrid, will fly to New York next month, and Tokyo the month after next, and will return to London the week after next. Nigel is described as a very lucky man, but his wife isn't very lucky because she usually stays at home. New vocabulary includes pilot, return, New York, Tokyo, Madrid, and fly. Workbook practice covers answering comprehension questions about the text and matching cities with countries before writing sentences about Nigel's travels. Grammar exercises practise asking and answering questions with shall/will using given cues, and completing dialogues using the cues given.

Lesson 课文

Listen then answer this question. Why is Nigel a lucky man?
听录音，然后回答问题。为什么说奈杰尔很幸运？

Listen to the recording and answer the question: Why is Nigel a lucky man?

Nigel is our new next-door neighbour.
He's a pilot.

He was in the R.A.F.

He will fly to New York next month.

The month after next he'll fly to Tokyo.

At the moment, he's in Madrid.
He flew to Spain a week ago.

He'll return to London
the week after next.

He's only forty-one years old,
and he has already been
to nearly every country in the world.

Nigel is a very lucky man.
But his wife isn't very lucky.
She usually stays at home!

奈杰尔是我们新搬来的隔壁邻居。他是个飞行员。
他曾在皇家空军任职。
下个月他将飞往纽约。
再下个月他将飞往东京。
现在他在马德里。他是一星期以前飞到西班牙的。
再下个星期他将返回伦敦。
他只有41岁，但他却去过世界上几乎每一个国家。
奈杰尔是个很幸运的人。但他的妻子运气不好。她总是呆在家里！

New words & expressions 生词和短语

pilot /ˈpaɪlət/
n. 飞行员
return /rɪˈtɜːn/
v. 返回
New York /njuː ˈjɔːk/
n. 纽约
Tokyo /təʊˈkiəʊ/
n. 东京
Madrid /məˈdrid/
n. 马德里
fly /flaɪ/ (flew /fluː/, flown /flɔːn/)
v. 飞行

Notes on the text 课文注释

next-door neighbour

next-door neighbour, 隔壁邻居。next-door 是一个复合词，作定语。

the R.A.F.

the R.A.F. = the Royal Air Force, 英国皇家空军。

He is only forty-one years old, and he has ...

本句中的 and 相当于 but（而……），起转折作用。

B — Vocabulary: Match cities with countries and write sentences

Match the cities with the countries, then write possible sentences about Nigel below. 为第一栏中的城市找出其所在国家的名称，然后根据奈杰尔的情况造句。

Cities: New York, Tokyo, Berlin, Bombay, Sydney, Madrid, Moscow, Rome, Geneva, Paris, Beijing, Athens
Countries: Japan, Greece, America, Germany, China, India, Switzerland, Spain, Russia, Italy, Australia, France

Example (item 1): Last week he flew to Madrid in Spain.
